scientific_integrity: A symbolic signed fixed-face calculation determines all reflection traces and is checked against independently enumerated complexes.
scientific_limitations: No integral lattice or equivariant homotopy classification
No new claim concerning prior rotation action, central half-turn, odd widths, or known nonequivariant homotopy type
The expanded latest source revision was accessible at abstract level only; equivalent inaccessible or unindexed work remains possible
Computational checks for finite widths are corroboration, not infinite proofs
scientific_scope: Reduced rational homology representation of the full dihedral group on perfect-matching complexes of the even Möbius ladder for all n=2k>=4. Relies on a published nonequivariant wedge theorem and exact forbidden-pair characterization.
title: Complete rational dihedral character of even Möbius-ladder perfect-matching complexes
